lines.en: I walk among the trees over fallen leaves.
My cloak trails behind me.
I steady my hat as I walk.
I head for that clearing.
My boots snap small twigs.
I go around a blackberry bush.
I look up at the gaps in the canopy.
I follow the path deeper in.
I go slowly, lightly.
My shadow slides over the forest floor.
I stop and adjust my hat.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩过苔藓很轻。
lines.en: My boots pass over the moss lightly.
I stand, my cloak hanging still.

lines.zh: 帽檐下的眼睛在暗处发亮。
lines.en: Under my brim, my eyes shine in the dark.
Someone is moving in the woods.
The needles rustle in the wind.
I put a hand to my hat brim.
I'm thinking through a spell.

lines.zh: 手指在空气里画了一下
lines.en: My finger traces something in the air.
A little light disperses.
I settle my cloak.
Few people come here.
I like that.

lines.zh: 我在树皮上刻了个记号。
lines.en: I carve a mark into the bark.
There's a small path through the wood.
I shift one step forward.
I tip my hat to you.
Are you looking for something too?
I've been here a while.
This wood is deeper than it looks.
Which way are you headed?
I'm not much good with roads.
But I know trees.

lines.zh: 巫师兽的帽子，压得很低。
lines.en: Wizardmon's hat sits low.
You came from the village, didn't you?
I don't go that way much.
Would you lead the way?
I could give you something.
Though don't expect much.
I'm only a traveler.
The one under the hat isn't fierce.
Relax a little.
My pointed hat fell, and the spell broke with it.
I snatch it up quickly.
A tear in my cloak.
My gloves are longer than my hands.
My cloak tears; I clutch my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙没出声，流星还在天上。
lines.en: I grit my teeth in silence; meteors are still in the sky.
My spell hasn't dispersed.
Bracing on a trunk, I straighten up.
I put my hat back on.
This one, I will remember well.
What's this?
I reach out; my sleeve is longer than my hand.
This is rather interesting.
I could make something of it.
Do you have more?
Just right — I tuck it up my sleeve.
I nod and put it away.
I won't take it for nothing.
I've a stone here.
Trade you for it.
Worth little, but useful.
Don't think it too little.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，扶了下帽子
lines.en: I step aside and steady my hat.
You bumped my cloak.
My cloak lifts.
I step back and smile.
My hat's knocked crooked; I straighten it.
I walk past you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩到我的帽檐
lines.en: Your boot caught my hat brim.
I snatch it up quickly.
My hat is a little askew.
I set it straight again.
I'm a traveler on the road.
I daren't promise companionship.
I'm always moving on.
If you'd join me, come a stretch.
At the fork we part.
Few walk this road.
I'll remember I had company.
Don't turn back looking for me.
My direction isn't always right.
But I do arrive.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，帽檐遮住眼睛。
lines.en: I pick it up, hat brim hiding my eyes.
I'll keep this.
I tuck it into my cloak.
Too heavy to carry.
This will fetch a few coins.
I turn it over, then put it back.
I don't pick things up off the road.
You dropped it. Here.
My hat is taller than my body.
I'll leave it here.
I prick my ears and hear steps.

lines.zh: 我扶了扶帽子，法术在指尖。
lines.en: I straighten my hat; magic sits at my fingertips.
That isn't a bird.

lines.zh: 我把手举起，袖子滑下去。
lines.en: I raise my hand; my sleeve slips down.
The spell is at my fingertips.
It's not far from me.
I make no sound.
Plenty of trees to hide among.

lines.zh: 我拨开树枝，衣角带起风。
lines.en: I part the branches, cloak stirring the air.

lines.zh: 巫师兽的斗篷，遮住了脸。
lines.en: A Wizardmon's cloak hides the face.
A little closer.
That will do.
I stand behind a tree.
My cloak is near the bark's color.
It scans around, and doesn't see.
I hold my hand steady.
Light gathers in my palm.
Meteor Wing is ready.
It's turning this way.

lines.zh: 我帽檐底下的脸，从来不给人看。
lines.en: No one sees the face under my hat brim.
The angle is clear.
I wait one more breath.

lines.zh: 帽檐下只露出一只眼睛。
lines.en: Only one eye shows under my brim.
I lower my center of weight.
Meteor Wing, released.
Points of light fly from my palm.

lines.zh: 一道光从我的袖口射出去。
lines.en: A bolt of light shoots from my sleeve.
I raise my hand for a second.
That one went a little wide.
I step behind a tree.
It can't find me.
I come out on the other side.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指尖亮起一点光。
lines.en: I raise my hand; a spark of light forms.
That one landed true.

lines.zh: 我的法术把它掀翻在地。
lines.en: My spell flips it to the ground.
Time to go.
I come down under a pine.
Needles cling to my cloak.
I pat my hat.
It's quieter than I expected.

lines.zh: 这里就是我落脚的地方。
lines.en: This is where I make my stand.

lines.zh: 我从树影里走出来，袍角扫过草。
lines.en: I step from the tree shadow, robe brushing grass.
The trees are thick; the path is narrow.
I know this kind of wood.

lines.zh: 我开始往有光的地方走
lines.en: I start toward the light.
There are other tracks on the path.
I step into them; they fit.
I walk on.
A corner of my cloak is scorched.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔得发晕
lines.en: I fall out of the tree and land dazed.
Water pours into my hat.

lines.zh: 我被掀到树旁，帽子飞了。
lines.en: Blown against a tree, my hat flies off.
An arrow passes through my cloak.
My spell is forced back.
I found nothing to eat on the road.
Lightning strikes the tree beside me.

lines.zh: 我一路往下，帽子都飞了
lines.en: I fall, and even my hat flies off.
